household.occasional_guests: Visiting parents and other overnight guests

priorities.space_planning_basis: Furniture, storage, seating and clear movement; no approved room dimensions
priorities.conflict_policy: Report conflicts for review; prefer considering a larger plot over silently shrinking rooms or gardens

site.preferred_setting: Quiet, cooler, nature-connected location near mountains, potentially around Dehradun

outdoor_allocation.basis: Fractions of total plot area, including associated planting, play space, paths, driveway and ramp

budget_and_phasing.visualization_scope: Complete finished house including first-floor furnishing
budget_and_phasing.possible_real_world_phasing: Build structure together; first-floor furnishing may wait

building.structural_design: Engineering not in scope; show a separate explicitly non-engineered perimeter/core frame concept and clear-span living/parking design intent

circulation.external_basement_access_purpose: Maintenance access without crossing family interiors
circulation.lift_purpose: Passenger and household-load movement, including laundry; shared clean-side landings beside stair core
circulation.lift_dimensions_and_product: Unapproved shaft reserve only; usable cab, doors, pit, overrun, fire safety and accessibility require specialist design
circulation.double_height: Optional modest stair atrium; removable before protected priorities

layout_relationships: Receiving zone near front entrance and formal front tea terrace
Receiving and family zones connected, but no direct view into family living or kitchen
Use spatial offsets and soft screens/curtains while retaining an open-house feel
Kitchen faces backyard with a garden view; family living retains garden access
Dining moves inward and may be smaller while retaining eight seats and usable clearances
Expand family living relative to the first study; pantry directly adjacent to relocated kitchen
Children reach backyard without crossing master bedroom or office
Master bedroom has private direct garden access
Covered verandas provide garden connection, rain protection and shade
Laundry exclusively on the clean side of the basement, with acoustic isolation and a practical lift route to discreet outdoor drying; no ground-floor laundry
First-floor office and Child 1 swap: office front-left, Child 1 front-right with private connected bath/dressing retained
Former private office WC becomes a common indoor first-floor WC with shared-circulation-only access
Child 2 entrance is near its bathroom side, mirroring the other bedroom approaches
Large operable glass windows or balcony sliders on every bedroom's outward-facing frontage; provide privacy, shading, insect screens and fall protection as needed
Move prayer to the former laundry corner, clear of the garden exit and away from toilets; move family WC to the front guest/receiving wet core
Widen drawing room by modestly narrowing the furnished guest bedroom; preserve its queen bed, wardrobe and reading seat
Master retains one toilet cubicle, bathtub, separate shower and two basins; reduce bath area to enlarge the walk-in closet
Gym and gaming rooms have equal usable areas
Three equal upstairs sleeping rooms enlarged relative to the initial study, each with private directly interconnected bathroom and walk-in dressing
Front and rear balconies are each continuous shared family spaces without internal privacy dividers; retain perimeter guarding

style.roof_style: Accessible terrace with planters and shaded seating

comfort.bedroom_glazing: Large outward-facing operable glazing in all five bedrooms; daylight/ventilation performance is unverified
comfort.ac_and_heating: Allowed as needed; reduce demand rather than promise elimination

parking.car_washing: Desirable subject to drainage and feasibility

planning.extent: Smallest workable basement; user permits expansion where needed for garage separation, circulation and the retained program
planning.arrangement: SUV/motorbike/scooter parking toward rear ramp landing; equally sized gym/gaming toward front, stores and clean-side laundry between where feasible
planning.openness: Garage compartment separated from occupied/food areas by full-height sealed construction and a protected two-door connection
planning.protected_clean_route: Stairs to recreation, food/general stores and WC without crossing the garage
planning.glass_separation: Desired where suitable; not a substitute for ventilation/fire design
planning.daylight_and_fresh_air: Desired from front, back and sides where feasible

rooms.extraction: Ducted source extraction to a professionally located outdoor discharge; opening a garden window is not a substitute

rooms.area_direction: Smaller than Study 003 so the walk-in closet is larger

rooms.location_direction: Former laundry corner; no obstruction of backyard entrance/exit and no adjacent WC

floors.bedroom_size_direction: Enlarge all three sleeping rooms equally relative to Study 002; exact dimensions unapproved
floors.suite_circulation: Bedroom to private walk-in dressing to bathroom; bathing/dressing interconnected without returning to bedroom; no shared access between children's private suites
floors.wet_dry_separation: Soft bath/dressing divider permitted; enclosed showers, extraction and moisture protection still required

balconies.access: Continuous shared front and shared rear balconies, without internal privacy dividers; rear also accessible from lounge without crossing private suites

flexible_spaces.selection_basis: Quiet, focus, daylight, garden view and sufficient furniture clearances

flexible_spaces.outdoor_drying: Discreet area reached using the lift and a shared route; not through bedrooms

pool.use: Family cooling, relaxation and children's play; not lap swimming

fishpond.priority: Below pool, play space and trees

outdoor.maintenance: Hired help; frequency and pool automation/service to suit actual needs, not fixed to fortnightly visits

services.generator_diesel_and_lpg: If retained, specialist-reviewed appropriate locations; not general basement storage
services.garage_ventilation_intent: Independent garage exhaust/makeup air and lower pressure than occupied areas; clean areas independently ventilated; MEP-designed monitoring, controls and commissioning
services.exhaust_outlet_constraints: Garage and kitchen discharges must avoid play lawn, pool/veranda, windows, neighbours and fresh-air intakes; exact routes/outlets unapproved

structural_visualization.feasibility: Unverified; engineering may require internal supports, transfer systems, larger members or plan changes

unresolved: Actual site, plot area and proportions, orientation, road and neighbouring context
Jurisdiction, setbacks, permitted coverage/FAR, basement permissions and buildable envelope
Soil, groundwater, drainage, structural and retaining design, seismic requirements
Candidate room sizes, furniture dimensions, floor heights, wall thicknesses and reviewed layout
Basement footprint, SUV swept paths, ramp geometry, access and safe occupied-area separation
Basement laundry equipment, acoustic isolation, utility ventilation, drainage/pumping and lift route to discreet drying
Four-stop lift product, cab/door/landing clearances, pit, roof overrun, fire protection and accessibility
Clear-span living/parking structural feasibility, transfer systems, member sizes, load paths and foundations; display proxies are not engineering
Pool dimensions/depth profile, barriers and optional fishpond feasibility
Detailed guest shared-bathroom fixtures and dual-door privacy/locking design
Service, LPG, generator/diesel, battery and water-storage locations
Cost breakdown, cost feasibility, approvals and construction start date

web.scope: Complete finished visualization, not a construction or cost certification
